name: Ground Angle

weightBudget.basis: One 35 mm sandstone pavement tile, rounded cobbles and shallow joints; 1024/512 colour atlases, lower resolution normal/ORM and Meshopt geometry.

reviewNotes: PDF page 3. Sandstone border forms an angle around the gravel bed. Native 35 mm mounting base, 10 mm datum, maximum 19.7342 mm. Preserve both arms of the stone border and uneven outer edge; warm stone caps separated from dark soil by individually checked height thresholds. Centre support is measured in source/render/LOD. Initial 0.55 rad atlas overlapped distant surfaces by 0.214 mm; regenerate at 0.45 rad and validate both tiers before publication. Probe confirmed a real overlap at the bottom curved rim (z=10.0004 and 10.1223 mm), with both samples inside their triangles; split at 0.3 rad rather than relax overlap tolerance. The 0.3 rad split passed overlaps but used only 8.08% of the atlas at margin 0.0025, producing visible small-island artifacts; reduce margin to 0.001 and repeat actual-size checks. Keep the exact mesh but separate the lowest 0.5 mm mounting collar into plain earth material, which needs no UV; visible terrain uses 0.55 rad and margin 0.0015. Validate useful atlas area and the complete render/LOD/shadow silhouette.
